name: Learn basic swing dancing
blurb: Six-count East Coast swing is the friendliest partner dance there is: one rhythm, a handful of moves, and it fits an enormous range of music.
gear: A class or a social dance night
steps: Learn the six-count rhythm: triple step, triple step, rock step. Say it out loud while you do it.
Learn the basic in closed position with a partner, keeping a springy bounce rather than a flat walk.
Learn the inside and outside turns.
Learn the swing-out or the underarm pass, which is the move the dance is built around.
Learn to keep the connection: a stretched, elastic arm connection is how the lead travels.
Go to a social dance. Swing scenes are welcoming to beginners and one evening is worth three practice sessions.
tips: Bounce comes from the knees, and it is what makes swing look like swing.
Stiff arms break the connection; noodle arms give no information. Aim for elastic tone.
proof: You dance several songs at a social night with different partners, using four or five moves.
